scope: Original minimal ownership/API design only. No code, build, test execution, hardware proposal or change to frozen predecessors. All validation below is inherited evidence or explicitly future tests.

actual_API_gaps.finding: Provider79 requires CLAIMED/PRIVATE_METADATA and zero effects/pending/ever_resources. Its acquire/zero/copy/retire paths cannot serve an exposed owner. Bypassing this predicate or casting bpn_token.anchor to steal jobs[token.slot].lease is outside its API.

Genuine OSPtr references live in the independent boot anchor. Public operations export no retained descriptor or scoped backing access and no effect bridge. A second registry or separate fake buffer cannot join these references to canonical history.

Unchanged c585 already supplies canonical claim/bind/begin/result/quarantine/private-retire. Begin records pending/history before returning; success clears pending only; any effect prevents private retirement. It neither invokes callbacks nor enforces a caller ordering discipline.

Frozen002 directly pins/configures provider79 and hard-binds its hash in receipts. It does not configure a different anchor/version. A new provider needs its own source/profile-bound control setup; the old receipt cannot be relabeled.

minimal_new_version.identity: A separately named/versioned native owner, not an adapter that modifies or accesses provider79 internals. The new owner embeds exactly one unchanged c585 registry and one canonical lease per three-page cohort alongside its actual retained references. No mirrored ownership registry; leases are never imported from another manager.
minimal_new_version.domain: Trusted platform installs exactly one owner for a physical RID/SID/vector domain. The new and old provider must not independently configure the same physical domain. Source-local registries cannot discover other registries or prove global platform exclusivity.
minimal_new_version.anchor: Boot-lifetime noncopyable anchor retains all actual descriptors, callback context, copied operation table and coordinator metadata independently of facades/tokens. No destructor/unload/reset escape. Preserve three 16KiB actual spans, MapperNone/physical mask/PAGE_SIZE/prepare-pair/alias checks from79 as requirements, with a new implementation and receipt.
file_split: owned_owner.h: opaque public token/snapshot and bounded requests; no registry/lease/view/descriptor accessors
owned_owner.c plus internal header: serialized canonical lifecycle, operation admission/result and private-only retirement
owned_native.cpp: actual retained refs and internal scoped dispatch, external-C bridge, C++17 shared-pointer mode
owned_control.cpp plus separately versioned receipt/profile: internal pin/derive/configure of this new anchor; no caller raw setup/address
minimal_new_version.control_protection: New high-level setup owns pin_empty after pure input/workspace checks. Recompute exact typed anchor extent including callback/context storage and bounded scratch. Translate all required typed control pages under the reviewed two-pass rules and unchanged <=8-page/<=16-query bound or refuse; do not enlarge bounds silently. Include new source hashes/setup identity/policy in a new receipt. Preserve original RAM boundaries, exact reserved union and explicit Unsupported dependencies. Opaque allocator objects remain the documented trusted allocation boundary, not guessed extents.
minimal_new_version.callback_lifetime: Copy the bounded operation table once during trusted boot setup; no per-call caller function pointer. Context must be owned inline in the protected anchor or separately retained with exact protected lifetime/ranges. Code/module residency remains a trusted platform prerequisite. No unload registration or caller destructor can release it.

public: owned_boot_configure(policy, workspace, receipt_out): internally pin/derive/configure this version once; no external raw setup
owned_acquire(request, data_iova, permissions, token_out): claim and bind actual three-page cohort in its single registry; no effects
owned_zero_private(token) and owned_copy_private_data(token, offset, source, length): private prefix only; source bounds/alias/lifetime checked
owned_run(token, operation_id, bounded_value_request, result_out): synchronous admitted operation chosen from fixed trusted internal table; no caller callback/address or exported view
owned_retire_private(token): only never-exposed, no uncertainty, no pending operation; complete-all then core-retire then ref-reset
owned_inspect(token, snapshot_out): bounded values/history summaries, no pointers or reusable authorization
proposed_API_contract.token: Opaque domain-instance identity + slot + nonzero generation. Resolve against the one live anchor on every entry; copied token is an identifier, not independent ownership or permission. Wrong domain/stale token refuses without poisoning another live owner. No adopt/import/rebind/reset API.
proposed_API_contract.internal_borrow: No public borrow/get-view operation. Inside owned_run only, obtain exact actual descriptor identities and checked spans from the same canonical job; hold all refs and explicit prepare pairs. Construct one invocation-bound internal view carrying operation sequence, lease generation, role/range and pending ticket. Dispatch consumes it synchronously within the owning module. No raw span/PA/descriptor escapes in result or is retained by callback after return.
proposed_API_contract.trust_limit: C/C++ trusted callbacks can illegally copy pointers or bypass APIs; scoped access is an enforced module/API discipline and tested invariant, not memory isolation. An arbitrary callback/plugin interface would defeat this contract and is not proposed.
proposed_API_contract.private_vs_effectful: New state validation explicitly distinguishes private prefix from effectful operations. Do not weaken private_core globally. Zero/copy/retire/complete/reset remain forbidden after any effect. Internal read-only identity/span verification may run for admitted effects under retained ownership, but changed identity/view, failed query or ambiguity quarantines and halts the domain. Query success is not device readiness.

ordered_operation: Under short lock: validate exact token, canonical lease, bound cohort, state, request, resource/permission/range policy, protected control/source/output aliases and available finite budget. Set domain busy. Reject reentry before any native callback; no lock spans native or operation callbacks.

While busy with references retained: perform bounded actual identity/span rechecks through captured provider functions outside lock. Reacquire lock and verify exact operation/generation/context and unchanged views. Any uncertainty halts and retains; it must not admit new cohorts using stale overlap data.

Under lock BEFORE any possible effect: bpl_effect_begin on the SAME registry and SAME job lease with fixed operation kind and conservative resource union. Store ticket plus coordinator invocation identity; close all private retirement/complete/reset routes immediately. Failure to begin invokes no effect callback.

Release lock; invoke the copied fixed internal dispatcher once with the scoped view and exact pending ticket. One journal entry covers one explicitly bounded operation. Every possible subeffect must fall within its predeclared resource union; separate independent callbacks require separate entries. No nested begin, unbounded loop, hidden additional effect or late journal.

After return under lock: invalidate scoped-use identity, verify exact echoed invocation/lease/ticket/operation and canonical pending state. Known supported success records REPORTED_SUCCESS; failure/unknown/nonmatching result quarantines with original first error and halts domain. Success is only a callback report, never DMA/IRQ/firmware completion proof. No pending ticket can be synthesized or completed by an external caller.

Only then clear busy for a known completed invocation. Nonreturn retains pending ticket, busy state, all claims/refs/preparations indefinitely; timeout/cancellation cannot free them or launch overlapping work. Public outputs commit only for a valid known result; refusal/failure leaves outputs unchanged.

finite_budget_and_states.states: PRIVATE_READY -> EFFECT_PENDING -> EFFECT_RETAINED on reported success; any uncertainty -> QUARANTINED plus DOMAIN_HALTED. Never ACTIVE or drained. EFFECT_RETAINED may admit another bounded effect but can never return to PRIVATE_READY.
finite_budget_and_states.budget: At most32 successfully begun effects for the entire canonical lease lifetime, including conservative begins whose callback later refuses without mutation. No wrap, overwrite, compaction, reset, generation recycling or transfer to a fresh lease to erase history. The 33rd begin refuses before callback; references and all history remain retained.
finite_budget_and_states.workload_admission: Select a finite reviewed workload with worst-case <=32 entries, including conditional/error paths; check its full remaining budget before first effect and keep domain busy across any reserved multi-operation chain. Unused capacity can remain unused; begun entries cannot be refunded. No external reservation ticket or reservation rollback erases effects.
finite_budget_and_states.continuous_driver_limit: This is a bounded first-workload coordinator, not a continuous driver. Repeated submissions/interrupt service will exhaust32. A future continuous lifecycle needs a separately reviewed durable lifetime/exposure-history design; logical close, reported completion or a new generation is not a safe mechanism to recycle exposed resources.

retention_and_retirement: Any begun effect permanently blocks private retire, complete and ref-reset for that cohort, even after success/no-op/empty logical queues. There is no exposed release, caller drain Boolean, force cleanup or physical unmap path.

Failure/unknown before or after an effect retains every still-owned descriptor and prepare obligation plus canonical claims; domain-wide halt prevents new work when identity/spans become uncertain. Do not promise ownership of a ref already lost through an earlier private reset uncertainty: halt permanently and report that exact uncertainty as79 does.

Only a provably never-exposed cohort may follow the original complete-all -> canonical metadata-retire -> ref-reset order. No complete begins while an effect reservation/pending/borrow exists. A facade dropping its token does not trigger cleanup.

No retry, rollback write, device reset, IRQ mask, table clear or recovery callback is implicitly harmless. This design adds none; any future such operation would itself require prior journal coverage and separate hardware review.
future_failure_tests: Join actual new adapter source with host TESTSDK stand-ins and canonical c585: record descriptor strong refs, exact same lease/registry and prepare pairs through private prefix, begin, scoped dispatch and result; no numerical fake view presented as actual native execution.

Cross-job RID/SID/vector/CPU/PA/IOVA conflicts, stale/wrong owner/generation, wrap/exhaustion and duplicate manager installation assumptions; quarantine retains conflicts. Seed counters only in test fixtures.

At first possible callback/subeffect assert ledger already pending with exact lease/resource mask and actual retained identity. Mutants skip/move begin, borrow wrong cohort, substitute PA, omit resource, clear history, substitute callback or callback context, release a ref or complete a pair after effect must fail.

Callback-table caller mutation after configure cannot redirect captured dispatch. Reentry into acquire/zero/copy/run/retire while callback is outside lock refuses. Result replay/wrong sequence/generation/identity and changed bound view halt, retain and preserve first error; stale foreign public tokens do not quarantine an unrelated owner.

Fault before/after every modeled possible application, including partial operation followed by failure. Missing return is modeled as suspended invocation: pending/busy/ref ownership remains, with no fabricated timeout success. Callback/result success never grants private retirement.

Exactly32 begins and the 33rd refusal; preflight insufficient composite budget invokes zero callbacks. No-op refusals after begin consume history. Effects cannot be laundered through successful logical close, token drop, zero/copy, private retire or new cohort alias.

Scoped view cannot be used through coordinator after invocation returns; no public raw-view/registry escape. Protected control growth and callback-context alias cases require fresh receipt; old79/control002 receipt must refuse newversion binding.

Keep ASan/UBSan, NDEBUG refusal and compiled mutation checks, actual target O0/O2 <=1024B frame validation, exact genuine SDK/shared-C++17 compilation and imports review separate from host results. Large staging lives in owned/caller workspace, not kernel stack.

inherited_validation_not_rerun.core: Frozen c585 records482 checks per mode and22 compiled mutants; validates metadata history/retirement, not native references.
inherited_validation_not_rerun.provider: Frozen79 records14250 checks per mode,17 actual-adapter/testSDK scenarios and16+5 compiled mutants; validates private ownership/order/reentry/fault retention, not exposure join.
inherited_validation_not_rerun.control: Frozen002 records1871 checks per mode,9 actual-adapter/testSDK scenarios and18+2 compiled mutants; independent source review c829 also records521 additional cases. These do not establish a new anchor profile.
inherited_validation_not_rerun.new_validation: Only existing input hashes and JSON construction checked in this design task; no new implementation, build, test or runtime claim.

non_goals_and_stop: No actual MMIO/PTE/DART/IRQ/firmware/publication/activation functions or backend are proposed here. No physical drain/unmap/free claim. No code changes to79/c585/control002 or fake models. Source-only direction requires separate admission before implementation; existing hardware STOP and GPU observer HOLD remain absolute.
